data.title: Efavirenz
data.summary: Antivirals & ART · Non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antivirals & ART_

**Class:** Non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI)

## Mechanism of action
- Non-competitive inhibitor binding the allosteric pocket of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase; inactive against HIV-2

## Pharmacokinetics
- Long half-life (40–55 h); take at bedtime on an empty stomach (food raises levels and CNS effects); CYP2B6 metabolism (slow-metaboliser genotype → high levels); CYP3A4 inducer

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Formerly the preferred NNRTI in first-line ART (TLE — tenofovir + lamivudine + efavirenz); now alternative to dolutegravir (TLD)
- Women who cannot take dolutegravir, or with rifampicin-based TB treatment

## Dose & formulations
- 600 mg once daily at bedtime (400 mg in some regimens)

## Adverse effects
- CNS: vivid dreams, insomnia, dizziness, poor concentration, depression, psychosis — usually settle in 2–4 weeks
- Rash in about 15–25% (usually mild, in first 2 weeks; SJS rare) — less severe than nevirapine
- Hyperlipidaemia, gynaecomastia, raised LFT, false-positive cannabinoid tests

## Contraindications
- Significant psychiatric illness (relative); hypersensitivity

## Drug interactions
- CYP3A4 inducer: lowers levels of voriconazole (avoid standard doses), itraconazole, protease inhibitors, oral contraceptives (use additional method), methadone, artemether-lumefantrine
- Rifampicin: can be used together (dose unchanged in most guidelines)

## Monitoring
- LFT, lipids; mood and sleep

## Pregnancy & lactation
Earlier concern about neural tube defects is not confirmed; can be used, though dolutegravir regimens are preferred.

## Viva points
- Bedtime dosing because of CNS effects
- Rash milder and less frequent than nevirapine
- Gynaecomastia and dyslipidaemia

_Sources: Khopkar ch.4 (Efavirenz); Wolverton 4e ch.11 and ch.66; current NACO ART guidelines. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
